fieldValues.title: Open business and replaced standings fit the spec as it is
fieldValues.summary: A lifecycle state gives open business as a native filter, and record successor creates the next standing with its supersedes relation; the prototype used plain fields for both.
evidence: Test 2026-11-27, build.676: find --lifecycle-state open returns only the open point; record successor made the record and the supersedes relation, deriving the relation from the lifecycle
record successor left the predecessor in its old state
A lifecycle definition was refused four times, one missing property at a time; type create accepted a lifecycleRef that did not exist
fieldValues.body: The package should change, not the spec. Authoring a lifecycle is harder than it should be.
